name: Seefelder Music Spring
beschreibung: The Seefeld Music Festival ushers in spring with open-air concerts, lively street music, and an idyllic musical picnic in the Kurpark. From traditional folk music to jazz, there is something for every musical taste. A vibrant weekend getaway for the entire family.
kurzbeschreibung: Spring awakening with live concerts, street music, and a musical picnic in the Seefeld Kurpark.
